text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka has received a letter from a fan.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A letter? Oh, it's from a young Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes… It's thanks to my fans' support that I'm able to enter certain races.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Still, it does feel a little strange.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm often complimented on my racing…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I don't understand how people can just watch on without feeling tempted to run themselves.
choice_data_list: It's because watching you run is satisfying enough.
It's because watching you run is satisfying enough.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Interesting… So, that's how they feel.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then… I suppose I'll have to make sure I keep running the way I do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Silence Suzuka has come to better understand the feelings of her supporters.
